I came to therapy because I feel like I'm breaking apart and don't know how to hold it all together. During my first session, the therapist kept getting my name wrong, calling me Jules and then Anita. I had to correct him twice that my name is Juanita. This was frustrating and made me feel like he wasn't really listening to me. It made me question how he can help me feel put together if he can't remember my name. I am now feeling unsure about whether I should go back for another session.

Juanita arrived feeling fragmented and ambivalent about therapy, admitting she felt "stupid" for even trying it. A significant relational rupture occurred as the therapist repeatedly misnamed her, causing her to shift from withdrawn to openly hurt and angry. This confirmed her core fear of being "invisible," which must be addressed to repair trust.
